Sam: Morning all — quick weekly from me. High level asks: Private GA readiness, p99 reliability, and cost optimization. Read and react.
Sam: Snapshot metrics: p50 28ms, p95 110ms, p99 220ms (+16% vs last week). Error rate 0.35% (-0.05%). Hosted RPS +12% w/w. Dedicated utilization 78%.
Sam: Main asks: 1) confirm canary windows, 2) update runbooks for new paging thresholds, 3) owners add measurable OKR checkpoint to Console by Friday.
Priya: Thanks — product side: GA docs + security checklist are done. Need one final approval on the billing UX copy. @Liam can you review pricing language by EOD?
Liam: On it. I'll send proposed pricing terms and expected ARR impact by 6pm. We're projecting a ~8% unit-cost reduction if we adopt the quantization recommendations from Optimize.
Jules: Reliability update: KV-cache improvements merged to staging. Canary planned tomorrow 10:00 PT (1% traffic). We've lowered app-level paging thresholds to reduce noisy alerts. Can teams flag any major traffic spikes scheduled then?
Maya: @Jules CS has no planned campaigns. I'll be on watch for the canary window and update the runbook. Runbook snippet I'm adding to the doc now:
```
canary:
  traffic: 1%
  metric: p99_latency
  rollback: 3m
  gates:
    - error_rate < 0.5%
    - cpu < 85%
```
deploy_bot: Canary job scheduled by jules — run id canary-5821 — scheduled start 2026-05-02T17:00Z.
Sam: :thumbsup: Appreciate the quick follow-ups. One more ask — everyone who owns an OKR, add a measurable checkpoint to the Console (metrics tab) by Friday so I can review before the next sync.
Priya: Noted, will add product OKR checkpoint and link to the docs.
